bull.probability_evidence: Bull case: every quality metric improved for five years (ROIC 10.6%->17.5%, operating margin 13.3%->17.4%, FCF margin 7.3%->17.1%, net debt/EBITDA 3.14x->1.72x), FCF conversion 113.7%, P/E 23% below peers and EV/EBITDA 13% below peers, 1.01% share shrink, low short interest (2.61%, -11.9% m/m) and Piotroski 7 -- no distress signs, so a re-rating toward peer multiples is plausible if fundamentals simply hold (research/BR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md bull case).

target_band.cite: Half the spread between BR's current price (160.13, factsheet Price section) re-rated to the peer-median P/E (21.8x -> 209.03 implied), EV/EBITDA (13.4x -> 183.40 implied) and P/FCF (12.6x -> 143.09 implied) multiples [factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table, peers FIS/SSNC/JKHY/ADP]: half-spread 32.97 / bull target 209.0 = 15.8%.

base.probability_evidence: Base case: multiples stay depressed but the 7.07% FCF yield and the 1.01% YoY share-count shrink from buybacks give a modest recovery toward the 200-day moving average (169.76) rather than a re-rating or further de-rating (research/BR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md base case; factsheet-2026-10-08.md Price and Valuation sections).

target_band.cite: Same valuation-anchor disagreement as the bull/bear bands (half-spread 32.97 between P/E-, EV/EBITDA- and P/FCF-implied prices at peer-median multiples [factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table]), expressed against the base target: 32.97 / 170.0 = 19.4%.

bear.probability_evidence: Bear case: the 32.4% 12-month de-rating is unexplained, P/FCF (14.1x) is already 12% above the peer median and P/B 66% above it, client concentration is a disclosed structural risk, and Nov 3 earnings could confirm the market's worry -- so a further fall to the 5-year P/E floor (14.1x, near the 52-week low of 133.83) is treated as ordinary downside, not a tail case (research/BR/2026-10-08-evaluation.md bear case).

target_band.cite: Same valuation-anchor disagreement (half-spread 32.97 between P/E-, EV/EBITDA- and P/FCF-implied prices at peer-median multiples [factsheet-2026-10-08.md Valuation table]), expressed against the bear target: 32.97 / 135.0 = 24.4%; below the blended residual vol of 24.46% (mc-inputs.json regression.residual_vol.blended).
